verses.en: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.
verses.sm: o ia. Nineva Ua alu ae i ou lava luma le na te faataapeapeina; ina leoleo ia le “o1o, vaavaai i le ala, ia fusi ae sulugatiti, ia matua faateleina lou malosi.

verses.en: For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.
verses.sm: Auá e ui lava ina taua i latou e i latou o e tafi, ma latou faataumaoi foi a latou la laau, a e toe faafoisia e le ALII le mamalu o lakopo, e faapea foi le mamalu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
verses.sm: O talita o ona tagata totoa ua faalanu ulaula ia, O tagata fitafita foi ua oofu i latou i ofu mùmù; e fepulafi faaafi o uamea o kariota i le aso e sauniuni ai o ia; e fuafua foi o latou tao.

verses.en: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.
verses.sm: E matuā feasofai kariota i ala tele, e soona fetaufetuliai i malae; e tino mai pei o sulu, e tele vavave pei o lc uila.

verses.en: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.
verses.sm: Ua manatua e ia ona alii sili, ua latou tautevateva i lc latou savali, ua latou faatelelise i lona pa, ua saunia foi le talipupuni.

verses.en: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
verses.sm: Ua tatalaina puipui o vaitafe, ua soloia foi le maota.

verses.en: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
verses.sm: Na faatumauina o ia, a ua faalelavalavaina, ua taʻitaʻiina ae o ia, ua gaegae foi ana auauna fafine e pei o leo o lupe, latou te taufaituʻi i o latou fatafata.

verses.en: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.
verses.sm: O Nineva foi na faapei o le vailepa ia talu mai anamua, a ua latou sosola lava. Tutu mai ia, ina tutū mai; a e leai se tepa i tua.

verses.en: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
verses.sm: Ia outou vete ario, ina vete ia o auro; e le uma le oloa lelei, ua faulai mea uma e manaomia.

verses.en: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
verses.sm: to Ua gaogao, ua faagaogaoina, ua faatafunaina; ua faavaivai le loto, ua gatete tulivae, ua tiga tele tua uma, o latou mata uma foi ua matamatavale.

verses.en: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
verses.sm: O ifea ea le ana o leona, ma le mea na aai ai leona taanoa, o le mea na fealuai ai le leona, le leona avilu, atoa ma le tamai leona, e leai foi se tasi na faamatau atu ai?

verses.en: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
verses.sm: Na saei e le leona ia maoona ai ana fanau, ua na titina foi manu mo ana leona fafine, ua na faatumuina ona lua i mea na maua, o Ona ana foi ua faatumuina ia i mea ua saeia.

verses.en: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
verses.sm: O loo faapea mai o le ALI o ‘au, Faauta, ou te tetee ia te oe, ou te susunu foi ia liu asu ona kariota, e faaumatia au leona taanoa i le pelu; ou te aveeseina foi i le nuu au mea na saeia; e le toe lagona foi leo o au savali. O le valoaga i le malaia o
